page.title: Game Objects
page.t: 200MJ Shield

The 200 MJ Shield is a medium protection shield. Typically used by escorts and some large transport ships. Shields are vital for survival in space. They protect the ship from small impacting objects like mini asteroids as well as during fights.\n
Colossus

The Colossus is the main carrier of the Argon military. As new technologies have been developed in recent years, the design has undergone several major overhauls. One of the fastest carriers, its large hangar capacity for fighters and strong shielding make the Colossus is one of the most powerful vessels in the Argon fleet.\n
Titan

Once the pride of the Argon navy, the Titan is now starting to show its age. Although heavy and difficult to manoeuvre, in the hands of a capable Argon captain, this ship is a powerful weapon with a noble heritage. Its predecessors fought and won many major battles in both the Xenon Conflict and the Boron Campaign. Since then the ship has been regularly updated and redesigned and it remains the longest serving ship in the Argon fleet.\n
Buster

The tiny Buster was once the pride of the Argon fleet and was instrumental in gaining the Argon victory in the Xenon Conflict. However, during the Boron campaign, it was superseded by the Argon Elite. Over the intervening years the design of the Argon Buster has been modified and new, more powerful engines have been fitted. Now updated, the speedy Buster is now the main scout of the Argon fleet.\n
Discoverer

The Argon Discoverer is light, versatile, and very manoeuvrable. It is the primary training fighter for Argon pilots with the more experienced being promoted to fly the more exacting Buster, Elite, and Nova.\n
Mammoth

The Argon Mammoth is a heavy transporter ship, usually found in Argon Federation territory. It is so large that it cannot dock at any normal space station, instead it is loaded and unloaded by docking some distance from the station, having its freight ferried backwards and forwards by fleets of smaller transporters.\n
Shark

The Boron Shark is one of the larger fleet carriers and replaces the much older and outdated Boron Cuttlefish. Its capacious hanger decks allow it to bring a large number of fighters to the party, and give it a significant influence in any situation.\n
Ray

One of the slower battleships, the venerable Ray is still a force to be reckoned with. It is well shielded and relatively manoeuvrable for a ship of its size, reflecting its technology, which was revolutionary when it first appeared.\n
Octopus

The Octopus was developed to be the Boron version of the Discoverer. Its design was revolutionary and all races, when it was first seen, were very keen to know how effective it was. The success of the Octopus sent ripples throughout the Boron sectors as more was produced, but today it is considered to be obsolete, although it is still in service.\n
Orca

The Boron Orca is a heavy-duty transporter craft, somewhat bigger and slower than the Argon Mammoth. It cannot dock directly at a space station and has to rely on a relay of smaller ships to ferry cargo backwards and forwards to it.\n\n
Dolphin

The Boron Dolphin is a cost effective transporter ship. Its unique Boron technology was developed and combined with Argon know-how to produce a transporter that can carry great loads whilst moving gracefully. It can be found in most Boron sectors, and is available in a wide range of models.\n
Raptor

The Raptor is the Split carrier ship. It first made an appearance in the war against the Boron when it proved to be effective but vulnerable to attack from beneath. It is believed that, over the intervening years, the Split have redesigned the ship to eliminate this problem, and it is still the fastest fleet carrier produced to date. Normally these ships are commanded by high-ranking Split officers related by kin to the ruling family clan. Generally they are even more abrasive and arrogant than the other members of their race.\n
Python

The Python is starting to show its age. One of the oldest battleships still in service, it is only as well-armed as a modern light battleship. In any capital ship confrontation, the Python would be out-gunned, and is therefore being replaced by the Taipan.\n\n
Mamba

A long-serving and deadly fighter, the Mamba is still a favourite amongst Split pilots despite the introduction of the Chimera and Cougar. In the hands of an experienced pilot, this ship can survive the darkest of battles, as its slim profile allows it to avoid most laser beams and missiles.\n
Scorpion

A forerunner of this ageing ship fought in the long ago Boron Campaign and proved to be a pilot favourite. Like most other Split ships, the design was focused on high-speed engines and increased weapon power, at the cost of shield strength. Over the years this ship had been frequently updated and rearmed in order to remain as deadly as possible, but now the Scorpion is a fairly run of the mill light fighter.\n
Elephant

This huge Transporter is too large to dock in any space station and often carries a smaller freighter to load and unload its trading goods. It is believed that this Transporter is an evolutionary form of a much smaller Transporter called the Rhino, which was phased out over many years ago. It is believed that a different Split family clan controls each transporter.\n
Zeus

The Zeus is the primary carrier in the Paranid Fleet. Despite being one of the smallest of all the fleet carriers, it still carries a reasonably large fighter wing. This ship`s tactics are to not get too close to battle, and to let its fighters do the fighting. Paranid pilots have been known to hide their ships in dense asteroid fields to keep their signature from hostile craft.\n
Odysseus

This was, until the advent of the Cyclops, the pride of the Paranid Fleet. It was developed from an earlier model used by the Paranid in their alliance with the Split in the Boron Campaign. It is believed that this ship has been updated numerous times during its long career.\n
Pegasus

This ship was designed to be the main scout craft of the Paranid Fleet; lightly armed, but fast. The Pegasus design is considered a success in its role, and has also been widely adopted for various civilian purposes. Constantly being updated, this ship dates back to the early period of the Paranid and Split war against the Boron.\n
Hercules\n

This ship is the largest transporter in the Paranid Fleet. It is too big to dock at space stations and employs a fleet of shuttle-craft to load and unload its cargo. It is commanded by a lesser Priest Baron, who is directly under the command of its original space station Priest Duke commander.\n
Condor
The Condor is the older of the two Teladi fleet carrier ships. It is, in most respects, a solid but unexceptional design.\n
Phoenix\n

The Phoenix heavy battleship embodies the traditional Teladi values of large, heavily shielded, but slow ships. As a combat ship it is, at best, obsolescent, but its huge cargo hold is larger than that of any TL.

If you have a cargo which absolutely has to get through, then the Phoenix may be the ship for you.
Falcon
The Teladi Falcon is one of the slower fighters, and has no outstanding features. It is, however, one of the slimmer fighter designs, so it is a harder target than its specifications would suggest.\n
Albatross

This huge transporter is too large for any space station and carries its own smaller transporter ship which loads and unloads its cargo. It is one of the best shielded large transporter ships, a testimony to the Teladi trait of preferring to last long enough until help arrives. Its basic design and technology is a hybrid between an older version of the Argon Mammoth and the Paranid Hercules.\n
Vulture
The Vulture is the trading vessel commonly used by the Teladi in all space sectors and can always be found wherever the largest profit is to be made, no matter in whose sector it happens to be.\n
J

The J betrays the Xenons` Terran origins. A multi-purpose ship, it is by far the most heavily armed of all the M1 carriers, but has the smallest hanger deck.

The Xenon J still constitutes a significant threat, but has been completely outclassed by many of the later Commonwealth capital ships.
K

This battleship was one of the most powerful ships the Argon faced in the Xenon Conflict and its memory still deserves the greatest of respect. It had formidable firepower and a great defensive capability. The Xenon in the last decades have updated this class of ship. This ship should still be considered as a major threat, although they rarely leave their own systems.\n
L

Until the appearance of the LX, the L was the most powerful Xenon fighter; compared to other M3s, it is lightly armed and not particularly well shielded. Like other Xenon ships, the L is known to have deliberately collided with the opposition.\n
M

The Xenon M is a fighter craft that first fought in the Xenon Conflict. It is fast and manoeuvrable. Although lightly armed compared to other light fighters, it is deadly as its combat AI is quite prepared to deliberatly crash into its target.\n
N

The N is considered to be the Xenon short-range scout ship, it is only lightly armed but very fast. In common with all Xenon ships, it will attack on sight, so its utility as a scout is largely negated by its high casualty rate. Called the "Skeet" by Argon pilots in reference to an ancient type of shooting competition.\n
Orinoco
The Split Orinoco is the most heavily shielded of the military resupply ships, and has become a favourite amongst the more adventurous traders.\n
Bayamon
The Bayamon light battleship is not to be taken lightly. Smaller, faster, and more agile than most Commonwealth battleships,the Bayamon was a nasty surprise when it first appeared.\n
Mandalay

Designed by the OTAS Corporation, this sleek and agile heavy cruiser is the ship the Auster should have been. Although not particularly fast, it is one of the finest ships being built anywhere in the X-Universe. The Argon military sees the Mandalay as being a mainstay of the composition of their fleet for many years to come.\n
Centaur

The Centaur was developed by Argon Shipwrights in Omicron Lyrae. One of the first corvette-class craft, armed with turrets and strong frontal weapons, the Centaur filled the gap between fighters and capital ships.\n\n
Nova

When the long serving Argon Elite was originally retired, the Argon military was left without an M3 fighter, that was until a group of Shipwrights in Omicron Lyrae put forward plans for a new type of ship. The Nova was born shortly afterwards, and after two years of testing, virtually all of the older Elite class ship had been replaced by this new craft. Capable of holding powerful weaponry and armed with an aft turret, the Nova is bound to serve the Argon military for many years to come.\n
Express

The purpose of the Express is to act as a passenger transporter for civilians wanting to travel between systems and stations. This was always a problem as passengers travelled in converted Lifter class freighters. But when the Lifter was retired from service, it was found the Mercury could not replace the job of transporting people. The Express was constructed by a group of civilians at Argon Prime out of old planetary transport hulls to transport its workers between stations. The Argon Shipyard saw the ship and became interested in its design, which was altered slightly to act as the newest passenger transport ship.\n
Mercury

The Mercury is the standard ship of the Argon Merchant Fleet. Armed with only a single turret for defensive purposes, the Mercury is barely capable of defending itself, and should be provided with a fighter escort in all but the safest sectors.\n
Hydra

The Boron Hydra is one of the smaller and more agile corvette-class ships, but is otherwise unremarkable. Developed originally to give extra protection to convoys of freighters, the Hydra now sees widespread service both as part of regular sector patrols and as escorts for capital ships.\n
Barracuda
Small and agile, fast but fragile, the Barracuda is the cheapest M3 fighter available.\n
Mako

A Major design flaw in the Piranha lead to it being decommissioned from service. After being left without a light fighter, the Boron Navy commissioned the Mako. It has more cargo space and is faster than the Piranha, but has similar weapon capacities. The design is loosely based on that of the Barracuda, as it is the same team of designers who constructed both ships.\n
Manta

The Manta is the slowest personnel transport available, and is completely unarmed. While it could be used for boarding operations, the generals of the Royal Boron Corps of Marines dislike it intensely, pointing out that a single highly-trained marine is worth several TPs, so should be equipped with the best assault transports. The Manta is now primarily a civilian ship, being used as a taxi, ambulance, and sanitation ship.\n
Dragon

The Dragon is the Split`s main corvette, and, despite early development problems, has matured into a deadly warship, becoming a firm favourite of Split pilots and many privateers. It is generally considered to be one of most potent craft in its class.\n
Jaguar

This ship replaced the ageing Wolf which had been in service since the Split first started to construct ships. The Jaguar is, itself, now overdue for retirement. One of the slowest scout craft, it is now best used as a primary trainer.\n
Iguana

This fast transport ship has been in service for many years now. The ship was originally built for slave transport, to ferry slaves from their point of capture to the factories where they would spend the rest of their days. Now the ship is used to transport personnel from sector to sector. It is armed with adequate weaponry, but its main defence is speed.\n
Caiman

The prototype replacement to the Mule, was nearly destroyed in the Dragon Incident, but it managed to save 100 people that were nearly killed as the docking crew tried to escape. The Caiman Project was continued in Cho`s Defeat where it was eventually finished, and put into service taking supplies to rebuild the Shipyard in Family Pride. The ship is armed only with a single turret and slightly faster than its predecessor.\n
Nemesis
The Nemesis is a competent but entirely unexceptional corvette.\n
Pericles

The Pericles was developed to replace the ageing Poseidon. The Pericles spent a long time in development as it had some structural flaws. These flaws were ironed out and the ship entered service to the sadness of the pilots who had become used to the sight of the Poseidon.

The Pericles is, in turn, starting to show its own age, and is likely to be replaced by the Theseus.
Hermes

The Hermes is based on the original design for the Demeter Prototype, but the design was re-worked to accommodate passengers. Now used for boarding operations when carrying marines, it is very lightly armed, and unlikely to be able to operate independently.\n
Demeter

The Demeter has been used for some years now, replacing the old Paranid Ganymede model. It has improved on all of its predecessor`s systems. This ship was first brought into service to serve only the Paranid Fleet, but later slowly replaced the Ganymede because of its speed to bring the Paranid Economy back to levels of the Argon and Boron.\n\n
Osprey

The Osprey is equipped with more defensive turrets and carries an extra shield generator than most of the other corvettes of similar age and size. The Yaki variant is slightly smaller and faster than the Teladi original.\n
Buzzard

The Buzzard was developed to replace the Teladi`s most successful fighter of its time; the Hawk. The Buzzard improved on virtually every aspect of its predecessor, especially with a third shield slot and much improved acceleration. Since its introduction a new generation of light fighters has appeared, most of which have comparable performance to the Buzzard. The Buzzard Hauler is currently the only light fighter with an eight-gun main battery.\n
Harrier

The Teladi Bat was considered to be the slowest M5 of its class, so it was retired and the Teladi Harrier replaced the ship. It is considered to be more profitable out of the two, with its significant increase in speed. As the Teladi Believe in profit the ships cargo bay has been extended to fit double the original capacity at the expense of shield space.\n
Toucan

The Toucan Prototype was the fastest ship in its class, but the standard model, at little more than a third of the price, is a relatively small, slow passenger transport craft. It is also lightly shielded and armed. The Teladi military try to avoid using it if at all possible, preferring the newer Naucell in almost every respect.\n
Atlas

The Argon military commissioned this heavy battleship after many years of speculation that the fleet`s durability was questionable. The Atlas specializes in durability. This ship can withstand heavy punishment, and is more than capable of dishing out what it gets.
Starburst

Allegedly, a well-known eccentric designer had a hand in creating this distinctive OTAS long-range heavy fighter. Originally a fast but fragile craft, it has undergone many modifications over the years, most of which were intended to improve its survivability by adding more armour and/or shield generators. Its engine and steering have never been upgraded, so it is now slow and relatively un-manoeuvrable, as well as being larger than any bomber currently in service.\n\nThe Starburst is universally disliked by Argon combat pilots, who refer to it as the Target, partly because it is used by the Aggressor units to simulate the Terran Claymore.
Arrow
As the USC is known for designing front gunning war vessels, as this design follows illustrates. The Arrow is a slow moving, yet heavy shielded heavy weapons platform.
Perseus

The Perseus is the Paranid`s primary fighter. Fast and agile, it is widely respected. The ship was initially tested with shields used for corvette ships but they wreaked havoc with some of the internal systems so they were changed for standard fighter shields.\n
Penatron

The Penatron was first spotted during a sustained pirate invasion in Elena`s Fortune. To the Argon`s surprise, this new ship appeared similar to Xenon fighter ship designs. Indeed, some pilots initially thought they were facing the Xenon LX.
Truelight Seeker
The Truelight Seeker is a modified Goner-designed vessel. It was designed to assist other Goner vessels should they require aid, and is still a viable escort ship.\n
Appallox

Intended as a replacement for the Heavy Dragon, the Appallox has not found much favour with Split combat crews. It is the largest corvette in the Split inventory, but also the slowest. Although it is one of the most agile escorts in service anywhere, some Split pilots find it unsuitable for dogfighting because of its relatively poor forward visibility and weak main battery, and its size.
Thor
The Thor is the heavy fighter-class of the Earth Fleet Forces; the ship is armed and equipped with highly advanced forms of technology.\n
Mjollnir
The Mjollnir is the smallest and fastest of the Terran interceptor-class fighters; the ship is armed and equipped with highly advanced forms of technology.\n
Valkyrie
The Valkyrie was the reconnaissance-class of the Earth Fleet Forces; the ship is armed and equipped with advanced forms of technology.\n
Susanova

Perhaps not surprisingly, considering the proximity of the pre-diaspora Yaki sectors to Paranid Prime, the Susanova Prototype is a close copy of the Perseus, albeit faster and with heavier shields. Production versions delete the rear turret and extra shield in favour of greater cargo capacity.\n
Raijin
The Yaki Raijin light fighter is a close copy of the Paranid Pericles.\n
Odin
The Odin is the primary Earth Fleet carrier, armed with advanced weaponry and fighter bays. It was designed to be a mobile base to serve Earth Fleet operations within the Sol system.\n
P
The Xenon P is their Corvette-class vessel. Its laser capacitors are small and recharge slowly, leaving it incapable of fighting for very long.\n
Ranger

The Ranger is very fast, very small, and very cheap. It is also completely unarmed and virtually un-shielded. Possible uses are exploration, reconnaissance, or as a decoy to distract enemy gunners. Usually piloted by condemned convicts hoping for a pardon, most users regard it as expendable.\n
Eclipse

The Federal Argon Government commissioned Bala Gi Research Inc. to develop a heavy fighter, larger than the current Nova, to fulfil a wider range of roles. The result, the Eclipse, enjoys a larger cargo bay than the Nova, at the expense of some speed and manoeuvrability. The Argon military also use it widely in training exercises to simulate the Terran Arrow.\n
Chimera

The Split Chimera was developed by Bala Gi Research Inc. following a successful tender to produce a ship that gave better long-range performance over the Mamba. Split defence experts view the Chimera as a logical step to delivering a heavy fighter with enhanced load-carrying capability and endurance.\n
Medusa

The Paranid government, learning that Bala Gi Research Inc. was to develop enhanced heavy fighters for other races, asked the company to investigate new design options for a heavy fighter to provide load-carrying capacity enhancements over the Perseus. The Medusa was the result. This new design fills a number of capability gaps that exist within the Paranid Fleet.\n
LX
The LX is a noticeably more dangerous fighter than the L, being faster and slightly more manoeuvrable than its predecessor, as well mounting more lasers.\n
Hyperion

Once owned by the Pontifex Maximus Paranidia and sailed under the name `Trinity`, the prototype of the Hyperion was an awesome vessel. It was the only M6 ever built which was capable of docking fighters. As originally designed, it was incredibly expensive, so the version now in service with the Paranid military is much less capable, although it is still one of the most heavily armed escort vessels in the X-Universe.\n
1GJ Shield

The 1 GJ Shield is one of the most powerful protection systems known and was once used on most carriers and battleships. It is now typically used on cruisers and some other capital ships. Shields are vital for survival in space. They protect the ship from small impacting objects like mini asteroids as well as during fights.\n
Tempestine

The Tempestine embodies the ancient Split spirit of pure aggression. The smallest of Family Zyarth`s "Shock and Awe" range, it is designed to unload vicious volleys of ordnance on a target with its 12 main guns. Slightly less manoeuvrable than other ships of its class, the Tempestine is still feared by capital ship pilots throughout the Universe. It is thought that the designers took inspiration from old pictures of the Terran Hayabusa cruiser, which it closely resembles.
Magnir

With the number of Terran billionaires and space-based entrepreneurs growing, the market for a strictly Terran-designed luxury cruiser was recognised. The Magnir is the result.\n\nMade to fill the gap in the civil markets, it is reasonably heavily armed and adequately shielded, though the actual luxury aspect has taken a secondary role. Although originally built to impress rather than please, the Magnir is capable of deploying a marine boarding party.
Naucell

The Naucell is an unusual ship; a luxury liner designed by a race with very little sense for aesthetics or luxury in general.\n\nThe design and controls were modified for non-Teladi pilots, as even the manufacturers of the Naucell realized that the ship would have little marketability among the Teladi themselves. Even so, the ship is still built on the tried and tested basic Teladi principles of high shielding and relatively low speed. The huge cargo bay is another bonus, allowing it to hold months` worth of provisions for solitary exile voyages.
Nomad

The Nomad is a fast, sleek and aggressive luxury cruise ship. Initially designed to serve as a fleet coordination and recon corvette, the need for such a vessel in Split military operations proved infinitely small.

 In order to avoid losing out on governmental funding, the design team quickly re-modelled the interior to accommodate several luxury suites and released the design to the general public.

Ironically, by stripping out the luxury accommodation the Split Navy have militarised it, and it is now their preferred Marine assault ship.
Elite
With the Buster having superseded the Discoverer as the Argons` main scout, the completely redesigned Elite now fulfils their light fighter requirement.\n
Heavy Centaur

Argon naval draughtsmen spent months asking themselves how to improve the Centaur. With better shields, weapons and engines \(it is still the fastest ever Corvette built\) and absolutely no frills, the Heavy Centaur Prototype was the result. Only a few examples were built before the High Command decided that its cargo hold was too small, so the extra shield and bigger engines were sacrificed. It is now only marginally more effective than the standard Centaur.\n
Cerberus
The Cerberus was designed as a response to the Split Panther, and is a fine example of the Cruiser-carrier hybrid.\n
Minotaur
Larger and faster than the Aquilo, and sporting a large array of launchers, the Minotaur is a swift and powerful ship, ideal for long-range engagements.\n
Gladiator
Roughly two and a half times the size of a Nova, the Gladiator is the smallest and fastest of bombers, and poses a credible threat to hostile capital ships and stations alike.\n
Magnetar

The Argon escort carrier, the Magnetar, was designed to be able to quickly deploy and retrieve a small number of fighters. This adds considerable flexibility to Argon fleet operations, providing fighter cover wherever it is needed most.\n
Skate
The Royal Boron Navy wisely waited to see how Bala Gi`s M3 Plus offerings were accepted before developing its own version. The Skate is the result and is an extremely capable heavy fighter.\n
Heavy Hydra

The Heavy Hydra is one of the biggest and slowest escorts anywhere. It can absorb a lot of damage, but cannot inflict much itself. It seems best suited to delaying an enemy to allow other units time to react.\n
Thresher

The Royal Boron Navy constructed the Thresher when it became obvious that the other races blamed the King`s Naval Treaty for weakening their forces before the Diaspora Wars.

As large, and as slow, as a battleship, but much less well armed and protected, it is generally regarded as a battlecruiser. Its distinctive silhouette makes it easily identifiable, greatly simplifying the opposition`s target prioritisation.
Kraken
This larger than average missile cruiser boasts correspondingly large missile magazines and gives the Royal Boron Navy an excellent heavy strike capability.\n
Marlin

This M6 is a private design offered to the Royal Boron Navy as an alternative to the Navy`s own designs. Faster and more heavily armed, it is a good match for the heavy corvettes of most other navies.
Angel

Originally a purpose-built transport for the Boron Lar and other members of the royal family and senior dignitaries, the Angel is now the preferred transport and boarding ship of the Royal Boron Corps of Marines. Its enhanced defensive capabilities and long-range communications lead the generals to favour it over the older Manta.\n
Pike
The Pike is virtually identical to the Mako, but generates significantly more energy for its lasers.\n
Pleco

One of the last ships to be commissioned from the old Kingdom End`s shipyard, the Pleco escort carrier offers increased flexibility and capability in convoy protection and post-combat recovery operations.\n
Krait

The distribution of this unusual cruiser`s weapons suggest that it was designed as a commerce raider, although it is too slow to run down many of the transports currently in use.

The heavy frontal battery combined with the light defensive armament almost forces the Royal Boron Navy to use it for direct attacks on enemy heavy units and stations. It is also effective at harassing retreating enemy ships.

One interesting feature is the positioning of the side turrets on outriggers, presumably in an attempt to give them as wide a field of fire as possible.
Asp
The Asp is more manoeuvrable than the older Scorpion, but not as fast.\n
Heavy Dragon
Acknowledging the need to maximise the potential of the Dragon design, Split military designers reworked it from bow to stern and the result is an even more formidable warship.\n
Tiger

Family Zyarth shipwrights have great affection for the Tiger.

It became their first major warship to enter service for many years after winning the heavy cruiser contract, narrowly beating the Family Whi`s original Panther design.

The precursor to the Shock and Awe family, the Tiger is still a force to be reckoned with.
Cobra

The first of the Shock and Awe ships, the Cobra missile cruiser is a potent warship, best used as a stand-off launch platform. As most Split officers have trouble fully understanding these tactics and how best to integrate this type of weapons system into a fleet, only the more tactically astute Split are given command of a Cobra. It is well known that these are, more often than not, the officers destined to reach the highest ranks within the Split Military, so the Cobra is often seen as a high-value strategic target.\n
Viper

Some say that the Viper looks like two Mambas which have collided and are now flying backwards, and wonder at the designer`s state of mind, but it is undeniably effective. It was the first bomber to be built, and its success has led to all the other races building their own versions.\n
Boa
The Boa is one of the faster escort carriers, but it is otherwise an average design.\n\n
Theseus
Faster and more agile than the Pericles, the Theseus`s greater reserves of laser energy give it the edge over the older design. It seems destined to become the standard Paranid light fighter.\n\n
Heavy Nemesis
The `Heavy` variant of the Paranid Nemesis is a complete redesign of the older model. It is a very potent corvette, with ramped up performance in almost every aspect of the ship.\n
Deimos

The Deimos cruiser-carrier hybrid strikes a good balance of armament, speed and shielding. Nimbler, but with otherwise similar characteristics to the Argon Cerberus, it is a good all-rounder, but is particularly effective when escorting task groups.\n
Ares

Larger than the Patroclus light battleship, the Ares missile cruiser is a fearsome addition to the Paranid Fleet. Although it mounts fewer launchers than other ships in its class, the Ares boasts much larger missile magazines.\n
Hades
The sleek lines of the Hades belie the steel beneath. One of the largest bombers, it carries more missiles than most.\n
Helios
The Paranid Helios escort carrier, adding the ability to carry fighter protection, enables the Paranid Navy to respond faster to emerging threats.\n
Kea

Though they first turned up their noses at Bala Gi`s multi-race rollout of M3 Plus designs, Teladi designers finally admitted that there is a place for this class in their fleet; the Kea is the result.\n
Heavy Osprey

In a bid to boost the overall combat capability of its corvette fleet, the Teladi Company ship designers optimised the internal design of the Osprey to maximise its shielding and armament capacity.\n\n
Shrike
The Shrike is surprisingly small for cruiser-carrier hybrid, yet can dock more fighters than the other ships in its class without compromising on speed, shielding, or armament.\n
Gannet
The Teladi Gannet is, perhaps, the most balanced missile cruiser in service today.\n
Peregrine
Confronted with an ever-rising threat of enemy capital ships, the Peregrine was specifically designed to help eliminate these dangers in the most cost-effective manner possible.\n
Pelican

The Pelican was developed primarily for convoy protection, after growing numbers of Teladi Company transports had been lost to hostile action, but is now frequently found providing fighter support to the Teladi fleet.\n
Kite
In an effort to keep up with the other races` combat ship development, the Teladi developed the Kite to provide a quick but more heavily-armed interceptor than the Buzzard.\n
Kestrel

A departure from conventional Teladi design, the Kestrel was an experimental design intended to increase the carrying capacity of a scout craft without compromising its speed and manouervablity. It didn`t work. The Kestrel is the slowest M5, and is larger than almost all light fighters, and even a few heavy fighters.\n
Tenjin

The Yaki Tenjin is one of the biggest and slowest fighters available. Its main laser battery is unusual, consisting of 9 mounts arranged around the rear of the cockpit. Not only is it distracting for the pilot to have his own guns firing from just behind his head, but it is also dangerous for two reasons: bailing out is unnecessarily hazardous, and it is less obvious when there is an enemy on his tail as the pilot cannot easily distinguish the enemy`s fire from his own.\n
Blastclaw
The product of rare collaboration between two pirate clans, the Blastclaw is a distinctive and destructive ship, which should be kept at a safe distance.\n
Carrack
Unusually good relations and cooperation between pirate factions led to the construction of the Carrack light cruiser. In typical pirate fashion it was built using mainly old or stolen ship parts.\n
Tonbo

Seeing the need to provide a quick but strong medium fighter to better protect transports and to bolster raiding parties, the Yaki have developed the Tonbo by upgrading the Raijin's shield and laser generators.\n
Washi

It is seen as a great honour amongst the Yaki to be given command of, or assigned to pilot, a Washi. It carries its sensor arrays on radial arms, which make the ship difficult to maneuver in tight spaces. Despite being entrusted to only the most accomplished officers, almost ever Washi ever built has suffered damage whilst docking or undocking.
Chokaro

The Chokaro was the first of the Yaki light carriers has been surpassed by their later designs, the Caravel and the Chokaro Advanced. The latter ship, with its increased docking capacity and greater speed is generally regarded as the best light carrier currently available.\n
Caravel
The Caravel is a near copy of the Argon Magnetar. With its ability to quickly deploy and recover fighters, its advent added to the aggression and organisation of Yaki and pirate raiding activity.\n
Fujin

The Yaki developed this small, fast and manoeuvrable scout to keep an eye on the outer reaches of their sectors and to accompany raiding parties venturing into other sectors. It is essentially a clone of the Paranid Pegasus, with similar performance to that of the Argon Discover and the Boron Octopus.\n
Vidar
The Vidar is a powerful Terran corvette. Quick and agile, it is a formidable opponent.\n
Aegir
More heavily shielded than the Kvasir, the Aegir is better suited for independent operations.\n
Tyr
The AGI Task Force maintains a considerable number of these heavy battleships, which provide excellent defensive and offensive options for the Earth fleet.\n
Fenrir
Not satisfied with the all-round capabilities of the Thor heavy fighter, the AGI Task Force came up with the bigger, stronger and more dangerous Fenrir.\n
Vali

Superseding the previous corvette, the Vali`s heavier shielding and weaponry meant that when on patrol or escorting a task group, the enemy would maintain a respectful distance. However, that was then, and this is now.\n
Skirnir
The Skirnir light missile cruiser is a formidable warship with the capacity to launch a large number of heavy weapons at installations and capital ships from long range.\n
Valhalla

The Valhalla is the AGI Task Force`s flagship and mobile command centre. Nothing moves in Terran space without the Valhalla knowing, and nothing strikes more fear into the hearts of Earth`s enemies than the possibility of having the Valhalla appear on their doorstep.\n
Baldric
The Baldric is the backbone of the USC`s logistics support capability, transporting wares, food and components to USC facilities to ensure ongoing operational capability.\n
Scabbard
Armed with only a single laser, the Scabbard transport is mainly used in the transfer of personnel between USC facilities and ships in the galactic core sectors.\n
Tokyo

The Tokyo class carrier, with its capacious hangars and heavy shields, became the USC`s premier force multiplier.

The Tokyo's unusual saucer was incorporated into the design on the advice of Terran psychological warfare specialists. They felt that such an intimidating ship should be easily recognisable, so that the enemy would know that not only was there a powerful capital unit on scene, but that they would also have to contend with the horde of fighters it carries. The problem with it is that it moves the ship's centre of mass away from the engines' natural thrust vector, so driving a Tokyo, especially a damaged one, can be uniquely challenging.
Osaka
The Osaka-class battleship boasts considerable firepower and enhances the USC`s ability to project power throughout the Solar System and beyond.\n
Scimitar

The Scimitar heavy fighter used to be the mainstay of Earth`s tactical defence capability and, as far as anyone in the outer galaxies knows, that may still be the case. This multi-role ship gives the USC an enviable degree of flexibility in mission planning.\n
Cutlass
Being larger than conventional heavy fighters, the Cutlass would normally be found escorting capital and large transport ships.\n
Sabre
The Sabre medium fighter was optimised for interception duties. However, since the Terrans left this part of the galaxy, it has been surpassed by many of the equivalent commonwealth fighters.\n
Rapier
Slow and poorly armed, the Rapier is probably the Terrans' main basic trainer.\n
Keris
The USC fighter drone was named after a small curled dagger; very apt, with its ability to confound even the most agile ship.\n
Katana
The Katana once represented the ultimate in USC combat vessel capability, and is equally at home supporting battle groups or on long-range patrol.\n
Corvette
Unknown data: this ship is not recognized in the database.
Aran
One of the largest ships used in the Argon diaspora, the Aran carried the last members of the now-extinct Goner religion to safety.\n
Ozias
The Goner TL Ozias, originally a gift from the Federal Argon Government, was one of the largest ships used in the Argon exodus following their defeat by the Terrans in the Diaspora Wars.\n
Boreas

No larger than many heavy cruisers, this OTAS-developed light battleship can easily out run and out manoeuvre any other battleship, at the cost of weaker shields. Designed to counter the Yaki Exterminator, it is superior to that ship in almost every way.\n
Eurus
More experimental tested than front-line fighters, the Eurus is relatively large, slow and generally underpowered.\n
Venti
Essentially a larger version of the Nova, the Venti heavy is a capable and deadly heavy fighter.\n
Notus

In order to reduce costs and improve reliability, OTAS simplified the Aamon by removing its capability to mount Terran weapons, and by slightly downgrading its power systems. The Notus heavy fighter is virtually indistinguishable from its parent.\n\n
Solano

Opinions differ on the Solano. Its capabilities fall between those of the Buster and Elite. Some say it combines the best features of the other two ships, while others claim it takes the worst of them.\n
Zephyrus
The OTAS Corporation designed the Zephyrus escort carrier to be bigger, faster, and equipped with more guns and stronger shields than the Magnetar.\n
Skiron
The Skiron represented a significant step forward in OTAS corvette design, with most areas of its capability having been enhanced compared to previous models.\n
Aquilo
A close copy of the Terran Skirnir, the OTAS Aquilo missile cruiser was, unsurprisingly, the inspiration for other races` forays into the heavy strike arena.\n
Auster

Shortly before the King's Naval Treaty was negotiated, the Federal Argon Navy realised that having a new class of cruisers coming into service may improve their negotiating position, and asked OTAS to design such a ship. The Auster was the result. Widely known as the "Mongrel", many think that it looks as if it was a rush job, created by combining whatever ship parts OTAS had available. They are not far from the truth.\n\nDespite its genesis, the Auster is a surprisingly successful heavy cruiser, and remains in front-line service to this day.
Sirokos
The Sirokos assault corvette is a fearsome machine, designed as a direct response to the appearance of the Split Heavy Dragon.\n
Q
The Xenon Q is small and fast compared to most Commonwealth light cruisers.\n
PX

A considerable danger in the field of battle, the PX is the OCV fleet's wing leader and common escort. These nimble corvettes pack and enormous amount of fire power for their size. As with all OCV craft, this vessel outclasses its commonwealth and Terran equivalents in nearly every regard.
Yokohama

The Yokohama frigate is intended to form part of a convoy or carrier task force escort group, its near-sister Cikyu being the other main component. Its frontal weapons suit it to covering the front of the convoy, while the Cikyu takes the sides and rear.\n
Claymore
The Claymore bomber provides the United Space Command with an easily deployable and flexible strike capability.\n
Spitfyre

Originally a Terrran fighter, the Argons reverse engineered the Spitfyre as an alternative to the Nova. No larger than its competitor, the Spitfyre mounts a second gun in the rear turret due to its use of the more compact Terran weapons. However, partly because the Argon copies of Terran power systems are less reliable than standard Argon technology, the Spitfyre is more expensive to maintain than the standard Nova.\n
Springblossom

The Springblossom class was originally a derivation of the Winterblossom design that was used to first explore the gate network. Slow but well armed, it is probably most often found as part of a convoy escort group.\n
#deca
This appears to be one of the huge CPU ships originally dispatched from Earth to terraform planets and has been modified for a defensive role.\n
#deca.cefa
Originally terraforming drones deployed from the #deca CPU ship, these ships appear to have been modified along with #deca to perform a defensive role.\n
Nagoya

The Nagoya class heavy carrier represents the pinnacle of USC carrier development. Emerging from the Mars shipyards, this capable vessel added a fearsome heavy strike and transport capability to the Earth fleet.
Griffon

The Griffon was the Federal Argon Navy`s attempt to provide a credible anti-fighter capability without endangering pilots. Unfortunately, its MkII Fighter Drones were little more than practice targets for enemy pilots, so the docking cradles were converted to handle manned fighters.

It is now classified as a light carrier, and is arguably the most cost-effective way to deliver fighter support in the X-Universe.
Tern
The largest of the light carriers, the Tern is notable for its internal hangers, which greatly simplify maintenance of docked fighters while in space.
Panther

The Panther is the result of a failed bid by the Family Whi Shipyard to win the contract for a new heavy cruiser. With some modification to install hangar decks and additional shield generators, it eventually entered service as a battlecruiser with limited carrier capability.
Agamemnon
One of the fastest big gun ships, the Agamemnon light cruiser is a worthy addition to the Paranid fleet.\n
Galleon

The Galleon carrier represents many years of secluded development and reverse-engineering by a cooperative of Pirate shipbuilders. As with other Pirate designs, the Yaki adopted it when they absorbed the clans.\n
Brigantine
The worst fears of shipping and trading companies were realised with the appearance of this pirate battleship. Military forces had to increase their vigilance in the face of this threat.\n
Ryu
As the Yaki seek to expand their sphere of influence, so must their infrastructure increase. The Ryu is a key part of enabling Yaki station-building and heavy transport activities.\n
Hoshi

The Yaki developed a very capable carrier vessel, stealing and incorporating Argon and Paranid designs into the final product. Even without its fighters, the Hoshi is capable of holding its own against some battleships.
Akuma
The line of battle counterpart to the Hoshi carrier, the Akuma is as powerful as any Commonwealth battleship of similar size.\n
Akurei

Along with the ATF, the USC fleet had lacked a proper small carrier class for long range fighter support. Never to be outdone by the commonwealth ship design, the Terrans launched the Akurei, one of the largest escort carriers ever built.
Kariudo

Essentially a larger version of the Cikyu frigate with a new bow section, the Kariudo light cruiser combines the capabilities of the Cikyu with those of the Yokohama. It is a perfect compliment to those two ships, and is most often seen as the command ship of a Cikyu/Yokohama escort group.
Senshi

Their first foray into the corvette class vessels, the Yaki Senshi is almost Terran in appearance. Initially disappointed in the design, various improvements have turned it into a competent combat ship.
Guardian
Unknown data: this ship is not recognized in the database.
Hive Queen
Unknown data: this ship is not recognized in the database.
Mistral

The Mistral freighter provided essential logistical support to the OTAS fleet until it was largely superseded by the Nexus.

Both the standard and the completely redesigned Super Freighter variants are in widespread civilian use.
Shuri

Due to the size of most Solar sectors in Terran space, the Shuri was commissioned for the specific purpose of a rapid patrol lead-point ship. Formerly an example of a successful rapid response corvette design, it is now a relic of a bygone age.
Atmospheric Lifter
The Atmospheric Lifter is a specially equipped TL-class vessel which is able to efficiently lift heavy freight and infrastructure from a planet`s surface to orbital and extra-orbital facilities.\n
Marauder

Building on their experience with the Carrack, the old pirate clans created the heavily armed Marauder light cruiser.\n\nUniquely, its nose section appears to have been designed to open and close like the gaping maw of some gigantic sea creature. Whether this was an attempt to intimidate its victims, or simply to make it easier to collect jettisoned cargo, is unknown. What is known, however, is that there is no record of a Marauder with its "mouth" closed, so it seems probable that the feature has been disabled or removed.
Woden

Designed originally as a possible replacement for the AGI Task Force`s Odin class Carrier, the Woden was designed to be even more flexible in its role. It was eventually decided that the Woden would be produced in small numbers and be deployed in less conventional carrier roles, while the Odin class would remain the mainstay carrier of the fleet.\n
Astraeus

Following the introduction of the Boreas, OTAS received some minor criticism at their apparent lack of heavy battleship capability. While the Boreas is still generally acknowledged to be the best light battleship in the known Universe, the OTAS perfectionist ideology quickly unveiled this M2 in an attempt to show that they were still the best at what they do. Many commentators doubted whether this was, in fact, the case, as it is broadly comparable \(although constructed to much higher standards\) with the pirate \(now Yaki\) Brigantine.

As though it were the worker drone of the OCV hive, this fast fighter works only as a transport to carry the valuable OCV resources they so cherish. This craft is often seen ferrying these resources between OCV stations, and preliminary reports suggest that it isn`t a combat oriented killer like its larger brethren.
The Yaki Exterminator is a vessel to strike fear into even the stoutest of hearts. Even smaller than the Bayamon, yet more heavily armed, it is one of the best light battleships in any fleet.
Baldric Miner
Baldric Miner
The Baldric is the backbone of the Terran USC`s logistics support capability, transporting wares, food and components to USC facilities to ensure ongoing operational capability.\n
Mobile Mining Base
This ship served as a base ship for nearby mining vessels, which would break up asteroids in the sector, retrieve any valuable resources and then unload them at this ship.\n
Excalibur

The Excalibur represents the finest in naval craftsmanship the Argon military has to offer. With internal M6 capable launching and docking, one of the most powerful shield arrays known, with weapon and power generators to match, and a fearsome armament, this heaviest of Commonwealth combat ships is capable of leading the longest of engagements and the most difficult of defensive and offensive military operations.
Lotan

With the increased demand for weapons and shields on the front lines, the Argon Federation required a ship to rival that of the Terran Bragi freighter. At first the ship was only intended for military re-supply tasks, however after many successful missions it was decided to be put into mass production in order to recover development costs.
Aamon
The brutish lines of the Aamon are a perfect example of form following function in this generally successful blend of Argon and Terran technology. A favourite of the Argon Aggressor Force.
Nexus

The Nexus was the first Argon military resupply ship. Designed by OTAS, it was outclassed by the Federal Argon Shipyards' Lotan. Not to be outdone, OTAS quickly introduced the much more capacious Nexus Super Freighter.
Quasar

Argon military academies have long believed that an light patrol is far more effective when the point lead is a well shielded corvette. The Quasar is essentially standard argon tech, with a few enhancements; most notably being the increased shield capacity and generator.\n
Sturgeon
The Royal Boron Navy's first fleet auxiliary was the RBFA Sturgeon. She was sufficiently successful to become the name ship of a new class.
Aquata
The bomber of the Royal Boron Navy, the Aquata is relatively big and slow. The large capacity missile magazines componsate for its lask of performance.
Megalodon

This ship is the Royal Boron Navy`s entry into the costly battle carrier arms race. The Megalodon strikes a menacing figure on the space battle front, capable of launching more fighters \(but no corvettes\) than its other Commonwealth cousins, while still exceeding the combat capability of any standard battleship.
Coelacanth
Cruisers are known for dying hard. The Coelacanth heavy cruiser dies even harder than most. Slow but powerful, it is definitely a ship to beware of.
Guppy

While not openly debated in Royal halls, there were mumblings amongst the military elite that the Royal Navy lacked power in their M4 class wings when compared to other navies. Bala Gi was hired to design the Guppy, a faster, better shielded medium-fighter to quiet these murmurs. The Guppy is now considered a very well rounded M4.
Emeus

The Teladi Emeus is a powerful carrier fresh off the Company`s shipyard docks, and, with the Pteranodon, provides greater operational flexibility than the other races' battle carriers. It is as heavily armed and shielded as many older battleships, yet carries more fighters than any other Commonwealth ship.\n\nMany military historians regard it as the most cost-effective capital unit currently available.
Geochen
Obviously influenced by Split designs, the Geochen light cruiser is one of the fastest M7s in the known universe.
Raven
A product of the design team responsible for the Geochen, the Raven heavy cruiser is a well-balanced and powerful combat vessel.
Cormorant
Intended to replace the ageing Phoenix, the Cormorant is a thoroughly average "treaty" battleship. It is a perfect example of the type of limitations impossed by the King's Naval Treaty.
Pteranodon

While the other races were knee deep in the race to develop their battle carriers, the Teladi instead divided their research into multiple designs. One of these projects resulted in the design of this interesting battleship. With minor docking capability, the Pteranodon is a perfect foil for the Emeus carrier.
Patroclus

The Patroclus was originally the losing design in the competition for the Paranid battleship-carrier contract. Removing its carrier capability, essentially by cutting out its centre section, created the highly effective light battleship we see today.
Proteus
Paranid hubris lead to the initiation of the Proteus design, with an overzealous dedication to trump the other commonwealth races in the effort to produce more capable point-lead escort ships.
Cyclops

As its name implies, the Cyclops is a beast of horror, if you`re on the opposing side. A deadly multi-role capital unit, the Cyclops mounts slightly fewer guns than other ships in its class, but this is more than compensated for by its ability to launch and dock M6 class ships in internal hangers.
Ariadne

Adding the Ariadne to their fleet gives the Paranid more flexibility in deploying fighter support. The most distinctive of any light carrier, it is unique in that its fighters are carried in external wings. This arrangement affords them more protection when docked than the external cradles of the Argon Griffon, while still being able to launch more rapidly than internal hangers would permit.
Drake

The Teladi design of the Drake competes with the new fleet auxiliaries, a class of heavy shielded military transporter ships with massive cargo bays. The Drake is known for its overall solid design and hosts one of the largest cargo bays in a TS class ship.
Ocelot

The product of a not entirely harmonious collaboration between the Split families, the Ocelot is the smallest of the standard battle carriers. It also has the smallest hangers and weakest shields, but is relatively fast. Despite the design compromises, it is a powerful multi-role ship, and can fly into the heaviest of skirmishes, launch fighters, and get close and personal with the most dangerous of battleships.
Cougar
The fighter component of the Shock and Awe family, the Cougar is the largest and most durable fighter in the Split inventory, and is generally well liked amongst the Split military.
Taipan

Certain that they could improve on the design of the Ocelot, but not wanting to compete directly with it for political reasons, Family Zyarth ship designers created the Taipan light battleship-carrier.\n\nAlthough significantly smaller than the Ocelot, the Taipan uses the same propulsion and steering systems, making it both faster and more manoeuvrable than its larger cousin. With a higher fighter:gun ratio, but with the weapon mounts distributed more aggressively, the Family Zyarth shipwrights believe that the Taipan is a more cost-effective design.
Acinonyx
Easily the most heavily armed cruiser in the known universe, the "Shock and Awe" Acinonyx is a fearsome warship. Any other sub-capital unit would be well advised to give it a very wide berth.
Tobosaku

In its day, this Terran heavyweight ruled the battlefield. Even now, should one ever appear in combat, it would be a serious threat to even the most powerful battleship-carriers in service. It may be slow, but once it arrives it raw firepower and massive shielding gives the Tobosaku the edge over any other pure battleship, and makes it the equal of the hybrids.
Cikyu

A uniquely Terran concept, the Cikyu frigate is designed to work closely with the Yokohoma as convoy and task-force escorts. With no main battery, its weapons are deployed in six twin turrets, 5 of which can fire to the rear. Thus, it is more suited to cover the sides and rear of a convoy, while the Yokohoma covers the front quadrant.
Toukon

Designed to counter the perceived threat of the new fighter drones, this unique corvettes mounts all its lasers in turrets. When it became clear that the drones were much less powerful than first thought, the Toukon came to be regarded more as a curiosity than a front-line combat vessel.
Hayabusa

Designed for fast point lead in patrols requiring heavier support, adding the Hayabusa to an escort group of Cikyus and Yokohamas, lead by a Kariudo, results in a very capable small task force. Due to its advanced technology, this Terran light cruiser-carrier hybrid is significantly more capable than any Commonweath ship of a similar size.

The USC fleet was in need of a smaller, more cost effective solution for factory transport and bulk movement of goods throughout Solar system sectors. As a result, the Tepukei emerged from Mars shipyards, supporting fleets and economic expansion alike.

Pirate clans organized their resources in an unprecedented manner to build the prototype of this fairly capable war ship. The Polacca, compared to other ships of its class, is small, fairly quick, and trades hanger space for additional gun turrets.
Logich

The Logich, much like the USC`s Shuri, was the result of an investigation into a faster combat vessel designed to lead patrols in the vastness of Terran space. With ATF command`s full weight guaranteeing the success of the design, this M6 was once one of the most feared in all space. This is no longer the case, as modern commonwealth ships easily surpass this centuries-old design.
Solaris
The USC Solaris is a light battleship armed both with lasers and missiles. The result is a devastating multi-role battleship capable of long range bombardments and close up encounters.
Shamshir
The Shamshir medium fighter design was a Terran concept based on survivability of swarm attacks against capital invaders of Solar system sectors. In its day, it was a very capable combat fighter.
Falchion

The Falchion emerged as a side project for the ATF amongst myriad experimental designs. With its heavy battery of bore-sight weapons, the Falchion is best suited to the unsophisticated head-on attack known amongst the old Terrans pilots as "playing chicken".
Macana

A dangerous corvette striking fear into peace loving citizens during pirate raids, the Macana is the result of Teladi and Argon technologies bastardized to create a fearsome weapon. Agile and robust, this M6 was a very successful design for the Pirate clans and is now a favourite amongst Yaki pilots.
Setanta
Following suit with forward gunning military vessels, the USC designed the Setanta as a fast and nimble forward gun boat. The main tactic of this class is strafing runs, and not long term engagement.
Morrigu
The Morrigu is a relatively new design by pirate clans to further enhance their mid-power vessel capability. This M6 is a relatively average combat vessel, with a larger cargo hold than most.
Verdandi

Many years ago, ATF commissioned a new light fighter. Surprisingly, it came in under budget, so the Verdandi was an offspring of that extra budget room. While not entirely required, the Verdandi stood on its own as a capable heavy fighter.
Kvasir
The Kvasir class M7 is one of the smallest heavy cruisers in known space. Its uncompromising appearance does not belie its capabilities.
Hel
The ATF released the Hel as a compliment to a medium-fighter attack wing. Although well armed for an M4, the Hel is generally regarded as a big, slow failure.
Bragi

The Terran military felt that they need a new transport ship to resupply their fleet close to the front lines, as they were losing too many Baldrics. The Bragi, with its extra shields, weapons, and cargo capacity fulfilled that requirement.

The ATF commissioned this scout fighter after a lengthy design process focusing on a more formidable scout craft. The Mani boasts 6 main guns, plus 2 in its turret, making it by far the most heavily armed M5 class vessel. Undoubtedly, the Mani is one of the most combat capable scout ships in the Universe.

It was obvious that the ATF had been lacking in a small ship transporter to augment mobile patrol fleets. With this oversight in mind, the ATF designed and launched the Lofn, an escort carrier capable of launching a larger array of fighters than most of its commonwealth counterparts.
Forseti

At first, the ATF were happy to skip the battle carrier race that gripped the militaries of other races, as they were confident in the abilities of the far superior Tyr. As time went on, however, the ATF decided to play it safe, and initiate the construction of a heavy carrier-battleship hybrid to close the gap between competing races. The Forseti is possibly the most powerful capital ship in the Universe, and is capable of internally launching and docking M6 class ships.
AP Gunner

The Type IV corvette is one of the oldest designs still flying today. Though it has seen many system upgrades, the actual chassis has seen very few structural changes since its original implementation in the schematics of the AP Gunner; the vessel which propelled Nathan R. Gunne beyond the Sol system and into the X-Universe.\n
Phantom

The Phantom was one of the last offerings from the famous Omicron Lyrae Shipyards. Designed to compete in the same market niche as the Hyperion, it combines luxurious interior suites with a reinforced hull and enhanced shield generators, making it the perfect vessel for use as a private yacht for the wealthy entrepreneur. The vessel is lightly armed, but is capable of defending itself from the scattered pirate raiders which plague the universe.\n
Kyoto

Recognising the need for a more powerful capital ship that would not be controlled strictly by the AGI Task Force, the United Space Command opted to develop their own super-heavy destroyer to perform tasks which the ATF would not. The Kyoto is currently one of the most powerful ships in service with the Terran military. It bears a close resemblance to the Nagoya, but closer inspection reveals numerous upgrades and reconfigurations of the internal structure, which result improved combat performance at no additional expense. A surprisingly large amount of the ship`s internal systems are operated autonomously without direct human supervision; a feature that sets this vessel apart from its cousin.\n
I

This heavy battleship closely follows the standard Xenon design principles, with its weapons distributed more to the front of the ship. Although fairly slow, its heavy shielding make it a dominant force. Like all other Xenon ships, it still contains a redundant crew deck, theoretically enabling living creatures to pilot it.\n
Snotra

The Snotra was designed to cover the one area the aging Demeter could not fulfil - rapid transportation of high value military grade hardware. Following the latest Paranid design trends inspired by prototype ships such as the Agamemnon and Heavy Nemesis, the Snotra has lost its former basic utilitarian structure in favour of a more elaborate, artistic profile. The core of the ship has not changed greatly, though - the basic cargo compression systems are taken directly out of other transporters and interior decorations have been left at a minimum. Though the Snotra was designed as a military ship, it is available to any trader rich and influential enough to afford one.\n
Albion Pride

This multi-purpose craft was conceived by the Argon Security Service as a long range reconnaissance and intelligence ship for use within the Terran Solar System. Its generally Terran appearance and its ability to use Terran weapons indicate that it was probably also intended for clandestine operations, and make it an ideal "Red Force" fighter.
Segaris
A response to the emerging light carrier market, the Segaris is a Boron designed light carrier capable of swift action when defending border sectors.

The O medium-fighter is a swift assailant; designed to reach the front lines of combat as quickly as possible. As with all OCV craft, this vessel outclasses its commonwealth and Terran equivalents in nearly every regard.

The R is the OCV fleet's most resilient M7. Massive laser and ship power sources give the R a considerable advantage in prolonged combat engagements. As with all OCV craft, this vessel outclasses its commonwealth and Terran equivalents in nearly every regard.

A troublesome M7, the G is, quite simply, a weapons platform. It is as much of a threat as some commonwealth battleships, but is vulnerable to attacks from the rear. As with all OCV craft, this vessel outclasses its commonwealth and Terran equivalents in nearly every regard.
Well-armed and dangerous, the C is nothing short of raw power. The Xenon have cut no corners unleashing this no-frills heavy cruiser upon the Universe.

It came as no surprise to many when the Xenon Z appeared through a gate in Boron space. It had long been suspected that the Xenon would improve upon their capital K design, and the Z is the answer. A powerful device of destruction, the Z boasts 64 guns around its massive hull, protected by a strong shield array. As an added threat, fighters have been seen docking and launching from its ports.

The monster, as some commonwealth pilots have named this vessel, is a beast of devastating firepower and shielding. Clearly, the OCV have learned from the hybrid designs of the commonwealth races when designing this frightening battleship. As with all OCV craft, this vessel outclasses its commonwealth and Terran equivalents in nearly every regard.

The OCV T is the ultimate super heavy battle carrier. A colossus of a ship, the T represents the culmination of eons of some unknown alien technology. It is, without a doubt, the most fearsome capital ship known. As with all OCV craft, this vessel outclasses its commonwealth and Terran equivalents in nearly every regard.

The OX is an elite OCV fighter specifically designed for speed, and carrier accompaniment. As with all OCV craft, this vessel outclasses its commonwealth and Terran equivalents in nearly every regard.

page.title: Races
page.t: The Argon are the most conventional power in the Commonwealth: a broad economy, a broad fleet, and few strong feelings about anyone. They sit near the middle of the galaxy's temperament - slower to anger than the Split, quicker than the Boron.

Argon designs are the all-rounders. Nothing they build is the best at any one thing, and nothing they build is particularly bad at anything either. If you are unsure what to fly, this is the safe answer.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

The Boron are the gentlest power in the galaxy and the least at ease with what it has become. Of all factions, they are the slowest to declare war, the readiest to accept a truce, and by a wide margin the most likely to hold your boarding against you. If you make a habit of taking ships by force, the Boron will mind first and mind most.

Boron hulls are the turtles: slow, roomy, and heavily shielded, but their anti-shield weaponry deals less hull damage than conventional weapons. They survive a long fight rather than win one quickly.

Boron-built ships also repair their own hulls slowly, for nothing, which no other yard offers.

For the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

The Split settle matters by force and consider that a virtue. They are the quickest faction to declare war, the least interested in a truce, and among the least likely to care what you have done to anyone else's ships - board as many as you please, the Split will not think worse of you.

Split designs are the glass cannons: the fastest hulls in the game, with heavier weaponry, but with weaker shields and fragile hulls.

They also want more crew per ship than anyone else, so a Split fleet costs population as well as credits.

For the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.
The Paranid are rigid, devout, and hard to befriend. They lean aggressive - readier than most to open a war and harder than most to talk down - but they stop well short of the Split.

Paranid ships are the brawlers: heavy shields and punishing close-range batteries, bought with cargo space, so they resupply often.

Their crews are efficient, and a Paranid ship needs fewer people than a comparable ship from any other yard.

For the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

The Teladi measure everything in profit, wars included. They sit at the exact midpoint of the galaxy's temperament: no strong feeling in any direction, and a price for most things. Only the Boron and the Argon are slower to reach for a war.

Teladi ships are the tanks: slow, heavily armored, and weakly shielded, with enormous holds. Poor duelists and excellent at everything else.

Their captains also value profit over duty, and a Teladi ship is markedly readier to bail out than anyone else's - which is good news if you are the one hunting it.

For the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

The Xenon are what became of the terraforming machines once Earth lost control of them. They do not trade, do not talk, and do not stop.\n\nThey raid more than they govern, and they take sectors. Every station they destroy sends refugees out into the galaxy - which is where the Nomads make their living.
Xenon ships are fast, heavily armed, and built for machines rather than biological crews.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

The Kha'ak come from outside the galaxy and want nothing in it. From time to time, they mount a raid on whichever empire has grown the largest, measured by the number of stations it holds. Build enough of them and that will be you.
Kha'ak ships fly in clusters and fight as a hive mind. They carry no cargo, take no prisoners, and do not retreat.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

Pirates hold no territory anyone recognizes, only bases tucked away off the trade lanes. They prey on freighters.\n\nBurn a base out and it stays burnt out, but they will put another up elsewhere eventually, and not always in the empty sectors - a base can appear in settled space, and in yours if you allow it in the configuration file. The galaxy carries a set number of them, and fewer of them the more territory the Xenon hold.

Pirates fly whatever they have taken, so expect anything. They build only fighters and corvettes themselves, flown hard and maintained badly.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

Private Corp. is one of the neutral trading companies rather than a power in its own right. It stays out of the wars, runs Trading Stations wherever a sector is safe enough, and sells to anyone.\n\nAttacking company property is a crime in every jurisdiction and is punished as one.
Company ships are freighters and the escorts that keep them alive. They are not built to fight and choose not to.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

Phanon is a machine faction that turned on the machines. It began as a development branch of the OCV and defected, which left it trusted by nobody and looking for an ally. That is where you come in.\n\nTheir empire is small and deliberately scattered, and keeping it alive matters more than it appears: if Phanon loses its last sector, the OCV cannot be beaten in that campaign.
Phanon fly machine designs, because that is what they were built from.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

The OCV are what the campaign is actually about. They arrive through the Maelstrom, a portal held open in a single sector, and they grow stronger the longer a game runs.

Every machine in the galaxy depends on a constant link to the AI Core behind that portal, and that dependency is the only weakness they have.

When an outbreak threatens, Terracorp can declare a galaxy-wide crisis: every war stops and every faction allies until the machines are pushed back.
OCV ships come in numbers, and numbers do not tire.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

The Terrans are the sixth Commonwealth faction, and the one that put the other five where they are. Terracorp is theirs, terraforming was theirs, and the machines now overrunning the galaxy were theirs before they got loose.\n\nThey are isolationist and hard to talk around, well toward the aggressive end of the galaxy's temperament. They also regard any sector holding Terran wreckage as rightfully theirs and will resent your holding one - which is awkward, because those are the only places their designs can be studied.

Terran ships are heavily shielded and heavily armed, but slow and weakly armored. They tend to be more expensive than other ships.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

For most of a campaign, the Yaki are not a faction at all. They hold nothing, field nothing, and exist only as the black market's supplier. Later, a slice of the galaxy secedes to them and they are abruptly a power on the Commonwealth's own ground.\n\nNothing offends them. Of all factions in the galaxy, they are the least likely to care what you have done or to whom, and the readiest to fight you over it regardless.
The Yaki supply ship designs to the Pirates. They fly a motley collection of modified designs.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

Terracorp is the Terran company that owns the arrangement everyone else lives inside. It sold the Commonwealth these sectors, did not mention the machines already in them, and administers whatever is left.\n\nIt is not a fleet and you will never fight it. It is the reason the galaxy has the shape it does and the authority that can call a galaxy-wide crisis when the machines break out.

Terracorp sends dropships to clients using Terracorp Intergalactic Storage \(TIS\). Each dropship is a TL-class ship accompanied by escorts. It jumps in, conducts the service, and jumps out afterward.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.

The Nomads are what the war leaves behind. They hold no territory at all - everything they are travels with a flagship that wanders the galaxy, living off the refugees the machines create.\n\nThey offer mercenary services cheaply and unreliably, and they strip battlefields. If there is wreckage worth having in machine-held space, they are already on their way to it.
Nomad ships are whatever could be built out of salvage, crewed by people with nowhere else to go.\n\nFor the actual figures, see Compendium: Ships in your Personal Console.
